stories.title: F-16 from Texas crashes in Michigan, evacuation order lifted

en.title: F-16 from Texas crashes in Michigan, evacuation order lifted
en.summary: A Texas-based F-16 fighter jet crashed in Grand Traverse County, Michigan on Thursday. An evacuation order was issued for part of County Road 633 but was later lifted.

stories.title: Japan Raises Interest Rates to 31-Year High Under U.S. Pressure

en.title: Japan Raises Interest Rates to 31-Year High Under U.S. Pressure
en.summary: The Bank of Japan raised interest rates to their highest level in 31 years following an unusual advocacy campaign by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent for tighter monetary policy.

stories.title: Texas Air National Guard F-16 crashes in Michigan, sparking hourslong evacuation

en.title: Texas Air National Guard F-16 crashes in Michigan, sparking hourslong evacuation
en.summary: A Texas Air National Guard F-16 crashed in Michigan, prompting a lengthy evacuation. The pilot ejected safely and received medical care at a hospital.

stories.title: Legal expert weighs in on Trump's threats to demolish Kennedy Center

en.title: Legal expert weighs in on Trump's threats to demolish Kennedy Center
en.summary: President Trump has indicated he may demolish the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. A legal expert examines the constitutional implications of such threats.

stories.title: S.U.V. Driver Charged With Murder in Los Angeles Bus Crash

en.title: S.U.V. Driver Charged With Murder in Los Angeles Bus Crash
en.summary: An SUV driver was charged with murder after a drug-impaired crash into a Los Angeles city bus on Tuesday that killed two people. A news helicopter also crashed in connection with the incident.

stories.title: Trump photo shows him viewing "Kennedy Center demolished" document

en.title: Trump photo shows him viewing "Kennedy Center demolished" document
en.summary: Court documents filed by a representative include testimony that a witness observed a forklift strike the pillars of a building.

en.title: Photo shows Trump viewing pile of rubble under words, "Kennedy Center demolished"
en.summary: The Kennedy Center closed Thursday citing public safety risks, with its Trump-appointed executive director confirming the closure. A photo showed Trump viewing rubble at the venue.

stories.title: Trump Air Force One Photos Fuel Kennedy Center Demolition Speculation

en.title: Trump Air Force One Photos Fuel Kennedy Center Demolition Speculation
en.summary: Photographs taken from Air Force One windows show President Trump viewing a poster depicting the Kennedy Center demolished, sparking speculation about renovation plans.

stories.title: White House withdraws Trump’s nominee to lead ICE

en.title: White House withdraws Trump's nominee to lead ICE
en.summary: The White House withdrew former Oklahoma state trooper Lance Schroyer's nomination to lead the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency without explaining the decision.

en.title: Trump says Kennedy Center could be 'ripped down' if he doesn't get 'recognition'
en.summary: The president made comments about the Kennedy Center after a federal judge blocked the performing arts center's board from adding a tribute to Trump on the building or site.

en.title: The Fed raises interest rates. And, EU proposes Canada become an 'associate member'
en.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in years, while the European Union proposed Canada become its first-ever associate member status.

en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased interest rates by a quarter percentage point to address inflation, raising borrowing costs across business and consumer loans.

en.summary: The Singapore dollar maintained stability relative to the U.S. dollar during Asian trading sessions.

en.summary: Japan's central bank increased its benchmark interest rate to 1.25%, reaching its peak since 1995, potentially affecting investment flows between Japan and the U.S.

en.summary: Oil prices declined during Asian trading as concerns about supply disruptions from Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline outage diminished.
